name: udi_search
description: Search China's medical-device Unique Device Identification register by product name, trade name, or model, refreshed from the publisher's release files. Optionally filter by registrant (manufacturer) name.

query.description: Product name, trade name, or model keywords (space-separated terms, all must match)

manufacturer.description: Optional registrant/manufacturer name filter (Chinese or English)

name: udi_resolve
description: Resolve one China medical-device Unique Device Identifier (UDI-DI) to its registered product record — name, model, classification, registrant, and registration number.

name: udi_manufacturer
description: Look up a medical-device registrant (manufacturer) in China's UDI register by name or unified social credit code, and see how many device identifiers and registration numbers it holds.

name.description: Registrant name (Chinese or English), partial match

registrant_id.description: Registrant's unified social credit code (统一社会信用代码), exact match

name: udi_recent_changes
description: Devices in China's medical-device UDI register whose latest published version is on or after a given date, newest first — drawn from the publisher's delta (daily/weekly/monthly) release files.

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — list devices versioned on or after this date

name: udi_coverage
description: Coverage of China's medical-device UDI register: device count, the full release and latest delta applied, and the data_as_of date. Registrant identity is withheld for individual (natural-person) registrants.
